ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_advantage_cost_gap_loss_with_weight_normalization_fixed
ir.intuition: Small fix to ensure the advantage difference receives gradients by using log_prob_w and log_prob_l; preserves weight normalization and cost gap scaling.
ir.pseudocode:
eps = 1e-8
cost_gap_clamped = clamp(cost_gap, 0)
weight_sum = sum(weight) + eps
normalized_weight = weight / weight_sum
advantage_diff = advantage_w - advantage_l
score_base = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
pairwise_score = logsigmoid(score_base * advantage_diff)
weighted_score = pairwise_score * cost_gap_clamped * normalized_weight
loss = mean(weighted_score)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    advantage_w = batch['advantage_w']
    advantage_l = batch['advantage_l']
    cost_gap = batch.get('cost_gap', batch.get('cost_b', batch.get('cost_a', advantage_w.new_zeros(advantage_w.shape))) - batch.get('cost_a', advantage_w.new_zeros(advantage_w.shape)))
    cost_gap_clamped = ops.clamp(cost_gap, min=0.0)
    log_prob_w = batch['log_prob_w']
    log_prob_l = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', log_prob_w.new_ones(log_prob_w.shape))
    weight_sum = ops.add(ops.sum(weight), eps)
    normalized_weight = ops.div(weight, weight_sum)
    advantage_diff = ops.sub(advantage_w, advantage_l)
    score_base = ops.sub(log_prob_w, log_prob_l)
    pairwise_score = ops.logsigmoid(ops.mul(score_base, advantage_diff))
    weighted_score = ops.mul(ops.mul(pairwise_score, cost_gap_clamped), normalized_weight)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.mean(weighted_score))
    return loss
